propositions: A standing eval spec for the concurrency overlay must be created to prevent silent regression of recall/precision behavior established by a traced bug corpus.
The eval spec must define deterministic scorers and a gate constraint (at_least(2) over 3 epochs) to validate that prompt edits preserve defect-detection capability.

The spec dataset must include at least 2 scored recall cases (TOCTOU and unlocked-write races with provenance commit references) and at least 3 scored no-fire cases (locked merge, atomic-write seam, and deliberate probe-then-skip).
The hard false-positive control (deliberate probe-then-skip with real lock) must be a scored passing case to distinguish benign skips from actual races.

The fail-open guard case (R3) must be present as a non-gating documented stretch (commented, not scored) because the current prompt capability cannot reliably detect it, so it cannot fail the gate by construction.
